name: Sensitive deepfake detection
detail: Detection technology mainly for China's cross-border network-data security, with both accuracy and recall at least 95%. The specified purpose is part of the boundary.

name: AI-driven malicious code
detail: Specified malicious-code generation or mutation usable against highly sensitive systems or national defenses, meeting one of the listed attack-success tests. This is not every coding assistant.

name: Adaptive malicious behavior
detail: Specified technology for adapting in adversarial environments or changing behavior while running, with listed evasion or rewriting properties and the sensitive-use qualifier.

name: Automated malicious variants
detail: Specified automated production and distributed deployment of evading malicious variants, subject to listed scale or performance tests and the sensitive-use qualifier.

name: Models trained on core data
detail: Large models trained using China's legally defined core data and then provided as services. The data category is determined by law, not by a model's brand.

name: Agents for highly sensitive settings
detail: Agents mainly for critical infrastructure, defense or core government settings that also reach the performance criteria referenced in 266505X.

name: High-accuracy deepfake detection
detail: Deepfake detection systems and equipment-manufacturing technology with both accuracy and recall at least 98%. This adds a point to an existing category.

name: Hidden information in images and video
detail: Embedding and extracting hidden information meeting all three groups of tests: robustness, false positives at most 0.1%, and near-imperceptibility. The attachment gives alternative metrics within groups.

name: AI-assisted vulnerability discovery
detail: Tools meeting any of six listed capability tests, including benchmark scores, independent exploitation capability or specified efficiency gains. Ordinary security testing is not automatically covered.

name: Voiceprint recognition
detail: Speaker-identification technology meeting any listed recognition, response-speed, anti-spoofing or minority-language/dialect criterion. Each test has its own measurement conditions.

name: Chinese and minority-language translation
detail: Technology mainly for Chinese and minority languages meeting a listed human-rating or semantic-fidelity and BLEU test. Language purpose and test conditions matter.

name: Models trained on important data
detail: Large models trained on China's legally defined important data and then provided as services, with qualified exclusions for trace use with safeguards or lawfully public data.

name: Advanced large-model core technology
detail: Core model technology if any test is met: at least 10^26 training calculations, at least 2 trillion parameters, or a qualifying global top-10 ranking at export time. Includes weights, checkpoints, code and architecture.

name: Agent planning
detail: Natural-language instructions split into at least 20 executable subtasks, with decomposition accuracy at least 80% and average subtask success at least 90%. All these conditions apply.

name: Many agents working together
detail: At least 60 concurrent agents, task time at most twice the minimum single-agent time for the same effect, and final-answer agreement at least 85%.

name: Tool-using agents
detail: At least 200 integrated third-party tools, selection accuracy at least 90%, and average end-to-end success at least 90% in tasks requiring three or more tools.

name: Strategic decision-making agents
detail: All three groups apply: at least 20 planning steps or 10 concurrent agents; adaptive decisions within 200 ms with at least 10 control units; and a standard game benchmark above 90% of humans.

name: AI processor design
detail: Design meeting any listed characteristic, including 14 nm or smaller fabrication, floating-point or integer capability, advanced packaging, fast links, novel architectures or named applications. It is broader than one chip-size test.

name: Memory chip design
detail: Specified 3D flash or memory design. Alternative flash tests include density, I/O speed or bonding; memory tests include 18 nm or smaller processing, vertical channels, bonding or multilayer stacking.

name: Fast cluster connections
detail: Inter-chip or inter-node connections with bidirectional bandwidth at least 800 GB/s in clusters with more than 10,000 AI accelerator cards.

name: Recovery during distributed training
detail: In clusters above 10,000 cards, any listed recovery or waste criterion, such as average checkpoint recovery at most 120 seconds, visible interruption at most 30 seconds or network-related wasted compute at most 5%.

name: Efficient cluster communication
detail: In clusters above 10,000 cards, any listed test: linear scaling at least 98%; specified routing and balancing with latency at most 1 microsecond; or communication hiding at least 90%.

name: Mixed-vendor cluster scheduling
detail: In clusters above 10,000 cards, unified scheduling or joint inference across chips from at least two vendors with a listed protocol, efficiency, recovery or geographic-scheduling property.

name: Cell and gene therapy platforms
detail: Chinese-owned original reusable technology platforms. The prohibition is limited to transferring ownership abroad; non-ownership licensing and specified services or single-drug work are excluded.

name: siRNA medicine platforms
detail: Chinese-owned original reusable siRNA drug platforms, with the same ownership-transfer boundary and stated exclusions for licensing, services and particular drug work.

name: Specified pathogen enhancement technology
detail: Specified artificial genetic modification or directed-passage enhancement technologies with any listed characteristic. This is a biosecurity category, not all biomedical research.

name: New cell and gene therapy targets
detail: Chinese-owned technology to discover and validate wholly new targets not publicly disclosed worldwide through the stated routes. Restricted-biomedicine facilitation applies to specified circumstances.

name: New siRNA targets
detail: Chinese-owned discovery and validation technology for wholly new siRNA targets, using the same undisclosed-target definition and restricted-biomedicine facilitation note.

name: High-capacity cold hydrogenation
detail: A cold-hydrogenation fluidized-bed process with single-line trichlorosilane capacity at least 250,000 tonnes per year, and equipment-manufacturing technology.

name: High-capacity silane fluidized beds
detail: Silane fluidized-bed processes with single-line capacity at least 20,000 tonnes per year, and equipment-manufacturing technology.

name: Ultra-thin wafers
detail: Technology for wafers 70 micrometers thick or thinner, including associated equipment-manufacturing technology. The note includes code, underlying algorithms and drawings.

name: Specified cell-edge treatment
detail: Solar-specific edge passivation for crystalline-silicon cells, with full-wafer edge lengths 182 to 230 mm and wafer thickness at most 140 micrometers, plus equipment-manufacturing technology.

name: Perovskite and tandem manufacturing
detail: Four specified routes: mass-production silicon-perovskite tandem cells at least 182 mm and 30% efficient; slot coating at least 1.1 m wide; single-junction modules at least 1 m2 and 18%; or tandem modules at least 1 m2 and 28%.

name: Large polysilicon plant engineering
detail: Single-line polysilicon engineering capacity at least 30,000 tonnes per year. Engineering includes equipment and building designs and process packages.

name: High-output reduction processes
detail: Reduction processes with polysilicon output at least 800 tonnes per furnace per year, and equipment-manufacturing technology.

name: Crystal-growing designs
detail: Specified solar crystal-growing designs, including chamber diameter at least 1,600 mm, thermal-field size at least 35 inches, pulling speed at least 1.2 mm/minute or equal-diameter power at most 40 kW.

name: Silicon-ingot machining
detail: Specified half-ingot cutting/grinding technology or machining technology for ingots at least 720 mm long, plus equipment-manufacturing technology.

name: Large or thin wafer processes
detail: Specified rectangular-wafer technology with any side at least 182 mm; or listed cutting technology for wafers at most 130 micrometers thick. The thin-wafer branch has additional wire or machine tests.

name: High-efficiency TOPCon and back-contact cells
detail: Six specified process groups cover coatings, diffusion and electrodes. Several combine 182 to 230 mm wafers with thickness at most 140 micrometers and stated production rates. The high-efficiency definition also applies.

name: Heterojunction cell processes
detail: Four specified groups cover conductive films, silicon films, low-silver materials and copper electrodes. Some branches require wafers at most 110 micrometers thick and further output or material tests. Check the complete high-efficiency note.
